# Made once with 0.3's build (project format 2), before the 303 generator (format 3), to keep a project as 0.3 saved
# it for app/tests/convert3.txt: proj_03.img. Run from fm1-eight: app/build/host/eight_host
# app/tests/fixtures/make_v2.txt OUTDIR (with the format-2 build only; kept for the record)
wait 600
expect projsize 31544
# ---- T2: two notes (steps 1 and 3: keys are numbered across white and black), its sound's FM at 30 (an update
# parameter), the part 12 steps long
turn ALGO 1
wait 30
expect trk 2
tap SEQ
wait 30
expect page 0
key 0 down
wait 20
key 0 up
wait 20
key 4 down
wait 20
key 4 up
wait 20
expect nsteps2 2
spin K1 -4
wait 30
tap EDIT
wait 30
turn SELECT 5
wait 30
expect epage 5
spin K2 30
wait 30
expect snd2_27 30
# ---- T3: one note on step 2
turn ALGO 1
wait 30
expect trk 3
tap SEQ
wait 30
key 2 down
wait 20
key 2 up
wait 20
expect nsteps3 1
tap SAVE
wait 400
expect dirty 0
expect projfmt 2
flash_dump app/tests/fixtures/proj_03.img
